_comment: Curated definition of the public team-share site. Data only — the generator is tools/build_site.py. Only list surfaces that are provably public-safe: the --public build genericizes product-surface/company names via SANITIZE in build_site.py and fails if any BLOCKLIST term survives. One-off prototypes and explainers stay private Claude Artifacts (per-person Share); they are intentionally NOT here.

site.title: Orbit Design Brain — Team Tools
site.tagline: The living tools for turning a rough idea into a testable concept — capture it, and watch the vault that grounds it stay healthy.

tools.title: Concept Brief Intake
tools.blurb: Capture a concept — the problem, the one user and moment, the testable bet, the outcome. Outputs a brief to hand to the design team. Everything stays in your browser; nothing is sent anywhere.

tools.title: Vault Health
tools.blurb: The sanitized, auto-updating health of the design brain: how many docs, how mature, which checks pass, how fresh. Refreshes daily.

tools.title: Run the intake pilot with your team
tools.blurb: The step-by-step playbook for testing the concept-intake loop: set up the two Claude Projects, pick testers, run the loop, and capture what you learn.

tools.title: Concept to prototype — the flow
tools.blurb: How an idea travels through the vault: coached into a brief, gated against the contract, explored as a throwaway concept, then ported on-system.

tools.title: About the Orbit Vault
tools.blurb: What the design brain is, what's inside it, how it's governed and shared, and the benchmark evidence that it works. Generated from the vault itself.
